description:
Consolidates 3 deferred items from dataframe-performance-optimization-and-analysis
(completed 2025-01-07). These represent the next tier of DataFrame performance
work beyond the initial profiling infrastructure.

Originally deferred 13+ months ago. The landscape has evolved - existing
adapters (Polars, Pandas, DataFusion, PySpark) now provide enough coverage
to start the cross-platform comparison without waiting for Modin/cuDF/Dask.

Deferred items:
1. Cross-platform benchmark suite - start with existing adapters (Polars,
   Pandas, DataFusion, PySpark), expand to Modin/cuDF/Dask later
2. SQL vs DataFrame comparison benchmark (DuckDB SQL vs DataFrame API;
   DataFusion SQL vs DataFrame) - both platforms support dual execution modes
3. Performance comparison report generation

deferrals.reason: Adapters for these platforms don't exist yet. Add to the comparison suite incrementally as adapters are implemented.
deferrals.summary: Modin, cuDF, and Dask adapter integration into cross-platform suite

work_units.notes:
Start with existing adapters. Define: which TPC-H queries, which scale
factors, which metrics (wall time, memory, CPU). Design output format
for comparison tables.
work_units.summary: Design cross-platform DataFrame benchmark matrix - Polars vs Pandas vs DataFusion vs PySpark on TPC-H queries

work_units.notes:
Both DuckDB and DataFusion support dual execution modes. Compare per-query
timing to quantify the overhead/advantage of each execution path.
work_units.summary: Implement SQL vs DataFrame comparison mode - run identical TPC-H queries via SQL and DataFrame on DuckDB and DataFusion

work_units.notes:
Generate comparison tables, highlight fastest/slowest per query, compute
geometric means. Integrate with existing ASCII chart system.
work_units.summary: Build performance comparison report generator - aggregate multi-platform results into structured comparison output
